parents.subject: Materials Science and Engineering
parents.course: Laboratory Studies in Materials Science and Engineering

ns2:section.sectionText: Students are introduced to emerging photovoltaic materials through hands-on experiments. Students fabricate and characterize solar cells made of materials such as organometal halide perovskites. Different methods to synthesize/deposit these materials and device architectures are examined. Students then critically examine advantages and challenges associated with integrating new materials into photovoltaics.
